about: Hand-kept judgement that no document records, joined by scripts/inventory/inventory.mjs with what it reads from the repository. A feature id is the generator's (section number and a slug of the checklist row); an id that matches no feature is reported in INVENTORY.md. Pass 2 (H106, at 876755a) adds the capability matrix: which user-facing capabilities there are (capabilities), the operator's screens (screens), the Mac rehearsals with no ledger row yet (rehearsals: r24 and r25, from the helpers' reports to the lead), the recorded test runs (suites) and acceptance (empty: visual and usability acceptance are the operator's alone, recorded only with by: operator, a date and a source). Every statement names where it comes from: the feature checklist, the ledger (CHECKPOINTS.md), a doc, a commit, a brief of round R4, or a helper's report. Ranges are estimates, never measurements.
